title: stachys arenaria var. angustifolia
intro: Stachys arenaria var. angustifolia, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Betony, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, offering benefits such as reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Narrow-leaved Betony include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, making it a valuable remedy for alleviating headaches, anxiety, and other stress-related conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
